findings.title: Null delegate is only handled in getSubGroupsCount; other getSubGroupsStream overloads can still NPE
findings.body: The PR adds a null check for modelSupplier.get() in getSubGroupsCount because the group can be deleted concurrently. The same modelSupplier.get() result is dereferenced without a null check in getSubGroupsStream(String, Integer, Integer) (line 256), getSubGroupsStream(Integer, Integer) (line 262), and getSubGroupsStream(String, Boolean, Integer, Integer) (line 268). If a stale cached group is accessed after deletion, these paths will still throw NullPointerException. They should handle a null model consistently, e.g. return Stream.empty() or invalidate/throw a controlled exception.

findings.title: Concurrency test asserts before reader thread has finished and can hang
findings.body: createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti starts a reader thread but never joins or awaits it. The main thread sets deletedAll and immediately asserts caughtExceptions is empty, so an in-flight request can fail after the assertion, and exceptions thrown later are missed. The test also does not guarantee that the reader performed any request before deletions completed. If a delete call throws, deletedAll is never set and the non-daemon thread may loop indefinitely. Use a latch/ExecutorService, wait for at least one read and for termination with a timeout, and assert after awaiting.
